_source: BUG-640 (2026-11-01, owner decision via the PM). OpenAlex's is_retracted is used only when OpenAlex is already asked for the entry (the title-search fallback, after Crossref found no match), only as a Low lead to verify, and never counts for readiness. Measured: of 30 works OpenAlex marks retracted, Crossref records a retraction for 17; of the other 12, about 10 are retraction notices themselves, 1 a retracted preprint Crossref does not mark, and 1 unverified. A notice is never treated as a retracted work.
_notice_note: A record is a retraction notice when OpenAlex types it as one, or when its title starts like one. Matched case-insensitively at the start of the title.
retracted_work_reason: OpenAlex marks this work as possibly retracted ('{title}'); Crossref, which did not find this work, could not confirm it. Possible retraction, please verify on the publisher's page: {url}. Not counted for readiness.
notice_reason: This entry matches a retraction notice in OpenAlex ('{title}'), not a research work. Please check whether the entry means to cite the notice itself or the work it retracts: {url}. Not counted for readiness.
unknown_url: the record could not be linked; search the title on the publisher's site
